title: add benchmark-lab performance suites and reporting pipeline v138
author: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Add v138 of benchmark-lab performance suites, representative workload runners, profiling baselines, and a reporting pipeline to centralize metrics ingestion for the performance dashboard. Motivation: unblock a new round of kernel-selection experiments and adaptive-batching tuning for recent Llama2-derived variants. This PR wires up workload definitions, runner binaries, telemetry schema updates, and a Terraform-based reporting pipeline so CI nightly runs feed the reporting system. What changed: 1) New performance suites (benchmark-lab/suites/perf_v138.yaml) covering mixed short/batch workloads and cold-start traces. 2) Representative runners (benchmark-lab/runners/representative_runners_v138.py) with improved request distribution and synthetic KV-cache priming. 3) Profiling baselines (benchmark-lab/profiling/baselines_v138.json) capturing kernel selection and memory peaks for a set of models. 4) Reporting pipeline (benchmark-lab/reporting/pipeline_v138.tf) that deploys a nightly job + ingestion Lambda and updates the metrics schema. 5) Observability: metrics schema and dashboards updated (observability/telemetry/metrics_schema_v4.yaml, docs/benchmark-lab/README.md). 6) CI: new workflow that schedules nightly runs and post-run artifact upload (ci/benchmark-lab.yml). Backwards compatibility: suites and runners are additive and gated behind a feature flag (BENCH_LAB_V138). Testing: unit tests for runner input parsing and telemetry serialization were added; end-to-end smoke on staging was performed. Rollout plan: merge to main, enable feature flag for canary infra, run 3 nightly runs, verify dashboards and no spike in ingestion errors, then flip feature flag for full autop-run. Checklist: - [x] Add perf suite YAML and runner code - [x] Add profiling baseline snapshots - [x] Add reporting pipeline TF and ingestion lambda - [x] Update telemetry schema and dashboard links - [x] Add CI workflow for nightly runs - [x] Run staging smoke and validate artifacts Known limitations: ingestion lambda uses a transient schema migration that will be followed up in ENG-1390. See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups.
